results.text: Orders can be changed or cancelled until they ship, usually within 24 hours of being placed. After that, you can return the books under our normal return policy.

results.title: Returns and refunds: Return window
results.text: Unread physical books (paperbacks, hardcovers and box sets) can be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery. Ebooks that have not been downloaded can also be refunded within 30 days. Books that have been read can't be returned for a refund, except staff picks under the Bookseller's Guarantee. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.
